text:
maya - marketing lead: Quick sync: publish plan for Saffron case brief. Need interview, legal release, gated PDF, and webinar mention by next Wed.
sam - producer: Interview booked Mon 10am PT. 20m interview + 10m quote drafting. I will record and transcribe.
diego (customer): Confirmed. I'll send two slides with metrics beforehand: throughput uplift, cost delta, p99 improvement.
jin - product marketer: Please capture baseline numbers so we can do a before/after chart for the launch post.
sam - producer: Deliverables: audio + transcript Tue EOD, two quote variants Wed AM, 500-word case brief after legal OK.
lex - legal: I'll need a signed release to publish exact figures. Send quote drafts and transcript; we'll return redlines within 24h.
tara - design: Reserving hero image + PDF template. Need final approved quote and logo usage by Thu to finish.
owen - sales: For gated downloads, route leads to AE queue and include webinar invite. Share SFDC campaign name with Ops.
maya - marketing lead: I'll create the SFDC campaign. @ops-bot please add the lead routing task to automation.
ops-bot: Task created: "Route Saffron brief downloads to owen.sales"  due 2026-04-07
sam - producer: Quick quote draft for review: "Redwood Inference reduced Saffron's per-token cost by 42% while improving 99th percentile latency, enabling faster user responses." Thoughts?
lex - legal: I'll review. If Saffron confirms the 42% we need explicit in-release approval; otherwise use approximate language.
diego (customer): I can confirm the number and will attach verification slides after the interview. Happy to sign the release.
jin - product marketer: Once legal clears phrasing I'll draft two headline options: benchmark-led and customer-outcome-led.
maya - marketing lead: Also plan a webinar with Diego as guest two weeks out, Wed 9:30am PT tentative. Owen, we'll add CTA in the nurture flow.
owen - sales: Got it; include a 2-slide SDR playbook with top metrics and qualifying Qs.
sam - producer: I'll draft the SDR playbook and the 2-slide enablement doc from the interview.
tara - design: Placeholder banner scheduled; final assets due Thu before publish.
lex - legal: Expect redlines within 24h of drafts.
maya - marketing lead: Summary actions: Sam run interview Mon 10am; Diego provide slides; Sam deliver transcript + drafts; Lex sign off; Tara finalize assets; Maya create SFDC campaign + webinar RSVP; Owen prep AE followup. Anything missing?
jin - product marketer: Micro-ask: include a short quote variant for social (one-liner).
sam - producer: Added to my deliverables.
ops-bot: Reminder set: "Check legal signoff"  2026-04-08
maya - marketing lead: Thanks team  will publish calendar invite after legal clears quotes. :rocket:
